title: Quantum systems on nanotubes.
author: Tiago Cavalcanti Rolim
abstract: The present work intends to give the solutions of time-independent Schrödinger equation for one atom with different potentials on a nanoscale cylindrical surface. The dependence of the binding energy of the atom in the potential well on the surface as a function of the nanotube radius was studied. We performed these analysis for potentials like the contact potential, the harmonic, and the Lennard-Jones one, semi-analytically and with the Finite Element Method (FEM). An existing Finite Element software, called LEVSOFT, which was developed by group of scientists of Instituto de Estudos Avançados (IEAV) was used.
